STATEMENT OF INTEREST:
Fresh Energy is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization dedicated to advancing Minnesota’s transition to a clean energy economy in order to ensure that our region enjoys good health, a vibrant economy, and thriving communities that are just, prosperous, and resilient. Fresh Energy’s team of scientists, economists, policy analysts, and educators develop and advance solutions that secure this vision. Fresh Energy is a Member of MISO, has unique experience and knowledge regarding the issues before the Commission in this docket, and has previously advocated before this Commission. Fresh Energy has an interest in MISO’s Large Load Addition Resource Study (LARS) because the rapid growth and fast load and generation interconnection have implications for transmission planning, system reliability, resources adequacy, and cost allocation. Fresh Energy’s pursuit of the public interest, including but not limited to the significant implications for affordable and reliable carbon-free electricity deployment as well as implications for state utility resource planning proceedings in which Fresh Energy is a regular intervenor, will likely result in Fresh Energy being materially affected by any decisions that the Commission thereby ultimately makes; therefore, Fresh Energy cannot adequately be represented by another party in this docket. Pursuant to Rule 214 of the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, 18 C.F.R. § 385.214(b), Fresh Energy therefore respectfully moves to intervene in the above-captioned proceeding.

Respectfully submitted,

Claudia Partridge
